desc: Analyze problem constraints and derive the crossing interval condition ($u_i < u_j < v_i < v_j$).
Design algorithm to compute `bad[i]` (first $j > i$ that crosses $i$) using a sweep-line with a balanced BST (set).
Design RMQ structure (Sparse Table or Segment Tree) to answer range minimum queries on `bad` array.
Implement the logic to parse input and normalize intervals to $(u_i, v_i)$.
Implement the sweep-line algorithm using a `set` to compute the `bad` array.
Build a Sparse Table or Segment Tree for RMQ on the `bad` array.
Process queries using the RMQ structure and print results.
